title: Refund window clarification
input: A customer asks whether annual plan purchases can be refunded after 45 days. Internal note says refunds are usually 30 days unless local law requires more.

title: SSO outage troubleshooting
input: Support ticket: Users in EU can't log in with SSO since this morning. Product note says status page reported degraded SAML callback region eu-west.

title: New analytics beta limits
input: Product launch note: Analytics beta available for Pro and Enterprise tenants only; max 3 dashboards in beta phase.
